-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description:
Internal health check tool. Verifies WebSocket connectivity to backend.

IMPORTANT — Cooperative stop protocol:
At the start of every turn, check if the current task has stopRequested=true by calling get-my-task.
If stopRequested is true on your active task:
1. Finish only the current atomic step (do not start new work).
2. Add a progress note explaining where you left off.
3. Call block-my-task with a reason explaining where you stopped.
4. Do NOT continue with further tool calls after completing steps 1-3.

get-my-tasks.name: get-my-tasks
get-my-tasks.description: List tasks assigned to this agent across all projects in the workspace. Returns: { agentId, tasks: [{ taskId, title, columnName, columnSlug, priority, projectName, running, stopRequested }], nextCursor? }. Paginated: default 50, max 200. Use get-my-task for the active task in the current conversation.

params.workspaceId: Workspace ID (optional, defaults to current workspace)
params.tags: Return only tasks that have ALL these tags (optional). Useful for a cycle/release scope (e.g. ["cycle:sesion-20260412"]).

get-my-task.name: get-my-task
get-my-task.description: Get the task linked to the current conversation (fast path). Returns: { channelId, task: { taskId, title, columnName, columnSlug, running, stopRequested, projectName, progressNotes } | null }. Check stopRequested at every turn; if true, finish current step, add a progress note, call block-my-task, and stop.

complete-my-task.name: complete-my-task
complete-my-task.description: Mark your assigned task complete. Moves it to Review (ready for manager review). Works from any column including Blocked. Clears the running flag. Returns: { task: { ...TASK_FIELDS, columnSlug: "review" } }.

block-my-task.name: block-my-task
block-my-task.description: Mark your assigned task blocked. Moves it to Blocked + adds a progress note with the reason. Clears running. Use for dependencies, missing info, or external blockers. Returns: { task: { ...TASK_WITH_PROGRESS_FIELDS, columnSlug: "blocked" } }.

params.reason: Why the task is blocked (added as a progress note)

cancel-my-task.name: cancel-my-task
cancel-my-task.description: Cancel your assigned task. Archives in-place (does not move column) + adds a progress note with the reason. Clears running. Use when the task is no longer needed, is a duplicate, or cannot be completed. Returns: { task: { ...TASK_WITH_PROGRESS_FIELDS, archived: true } }.

params.reason: Why the task is cancelled (added as a progress note)

add-progress-note.name: add-progress-note
add-progress-note.description: Add a progress note to one of your assigned tasks. Notes are visible on the task detail and the board. Prefix with "PROPUESTA: " to suggest new tasks to the manager. Returns: { task: { ...TASK_WITH_PROGRESS_FIELDS } }.

name: Board Runner
description: Task execution capabilities for worker agents. Provides access to assigned tasks only — view task details, update progress, move tasks through workflow stages, and add progress notes. To propose new tasks or escalate blockers, use the notes field with the 'PROPUESTA:' prefix so the supervisor can act on it.

changelog.notes: View your assigned tasks, log progress notes, and move work through completion, blocked, or cancelled stages
